name: zanker-preview-server
description: Launch a local studio to present visual options and capture approvals.

workflow.instruction: Prepare concepts file according to schemas/concept.schema.json.
Run `bash ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/studio.sh --project . --concepts PATH` (default binds loopback and generates session token).
Share local URL with project owner; inspect saved feedback events.
Shut down server when finished; do not expose it publicly.

fallback: Present HTML mockups or screenshot set without server.
